body:
Hi @avremel,

Are you using the [`<Head>` component from `next/head`](https://nextjs.org/docs/api-reference/next/head) ?
This overrides the title when rerendered, maybe that could be it ?

Otherwise I did some debugging on my side, I see that `windowTitle` runs twice but with the same `routeState`, maybe something in `facetConfig` changes in between ?
